name: Two Week Notice
source: Two Week Notice is a kinetic, lighthearted slice of life. It follows Nathan, a wage slave, as he interacts with his coworkers during brain-numbing shifts at 5-Twelve™ throughout the course of a week. After one of his shifts he meets a beautiful girl. Will this be enough to break the tedious routine?
